channel.title: Dancing About Architecture
channel.itunes:author: Webmaster@hypercubism.com
channel.description: Dancing About Architecture is a musical autobiography - the non-linear story of a chunk of my life told through the music I listened to. Part confessional, part critique, part unabashed fanboy rantings, Dancing About Architecture is a coming of age story set to the music of the end of the second millenium, told one artist at a time. Personal anecdotes are interwoven with information about the musicians and examples of their music. From Art of Noise and Eddie Arnold through Queen and Yello to David Darling and Slim Whitman and back again by way of Interlochen, Chicago, NYC, Amherst, and LA.
